question: What were case reserves outstanding on bodily-injury claims at 31 December 2025?
final_text:
Case reserves on open bodily-injury claims at 31 December 2025 total £11,574,541.29.

I summed the RESERVE transactions per claim (cumulative to 31 Dec 2025) for all bodily-injury claims with no closed date. Those are 675 open claims, and none has a negative balance. Closed claims net to exactly zero, which supports treating the RESERVE sum as the outstanding balance. No transactions are dated after the valuation date.

ANSWER: 11574541.29

input.query: SELECT 'peril' AS f, peril AS v, COUNT(*) n FROM claim GROUP BY peril UNION ALL SELECT 'txn_type', txn_type, COUNT(*) FROM claim_txn GROUP BY txn_type UNION ALL SELECT 'cost_type', cost_type, COUNT(*) FROM claim_txn GROUP BY cost_type ORDER BY 1,2

input.query: SELECT c.claim_id, c.peril, c.report_date, c.closed_date, t.txn_date, t.txn_type, t.cost_type, t.amount FROM claim c JOIN claim_txn t USING(claim_id) WHERE c.claim_id IN (SELECT claim_id FROM claim LIMIT 3) ORDER BY 1,5

WITH r AS (
 SELECT c.claim_id, c.closed_date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='RESERVE' AND t.txn_date<=DATE '2025-12-31' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) res,
 MAX(t.txn_date) last_txn, SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='RESERVE' AND t.txn_date>DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_res
 FROM claim c LEFT JOIN claim_txn t USING(claim_id) WHERE c.peril='BODILY_INJURY' GROUP BY c.claim_id, c.closed_date)
SELECT CASE WHEN closed_date IS NULL THEN 'open_null' WHEN closed_date>DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'closed_after_ye' ELSE 'closed_by_ye' END status,
 COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(res),2) reserve_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(res)>0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonzero, SUM(future_res) fut, SUM(CASE WHEN last_txn>DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late_txn
FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT c.claim_id, SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='RESERVE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) res FROM claim c JOIN claim_txn t USING(claim_id) WHERE c.peril='BODILY_INJURY' AND c.closed_date IS NULL GROUP BY c.claim_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN res<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN res>0 THEN res ELSE 0 END) pos_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN res<0 THEN res ELSE 0 END) neg_sum, ROUND(SUM(res),2) net FROM r
